notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Someone discovered that a few arts were missing, and I traced it back to the thing that loads dialogue art dynamically being busted. Most of the art in the game is pre-loaded and doesn't use this system, but a couple things do. There were some missing stills in a Cafe miniscene, for sure, and there might be a couple others. Either way, they're fixed now!
[list]
[*] Missing art in a cafe miniscene has been fixed
[*] A dialogue portrait of Cadence's cat has been updated to be less freaky looking
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's time for update 1.08! This update includes:
[list]
[*] new miniscene in the Root St Alleyway. Must have made considerable progress with Calico to access.
[*] Made the Cadence miniscene in the Root St Alleyway no longer autostart. You now click on Cadence to start the miniscene.
[*] revised my least favorite Cadence Email Selfie art
[*] fixed lighting in Sunshine Girders
[*] Makes Quinn wear his alt outfit in the Convenience store after you've made progress with Mags Quinn, and gives him a few new lines of dialogue
[*] added a not-very-helpful help button to the settings menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
This update includes:

[list]
[*] Spelling fixing for some interactions in the Candle Wax Club.
[*] Spelling fixes in Beryl 10.
[*] A background art has been changed for continuity in Heather scenes.
[*] Fixed a background detail on skipnoise ave.
[*] Background art of a "Free Use Friday" sign added the the Candle Wax Club, which appears only on Free-Use-Fridays.
[/list]
And finally:

[list]
[*] Two new miniscenes have been added the the Candle Wax Club. Both are part of the Free-Use-Friday theme and include animations.
[/list]
Its possible that if you've already done a bunch of Free-Use-Friday interactions that one of the two new miniscenes will be inaccessible. If you suspect that's the case, you can enter this cheat code in HCs room terminal to reset the Free-Use-Friday tracking variable: "fuf_forever"
Enjoy the new build! Let me know in the comments if there are any bugs or whatever!

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
This update is mostly spelling corrections, fixes to sub-pixel misalignment in some small world details, and some small background animations being restored (such as the neon signs outside and inside the Lemon flickering.)

There is also a really small content addition to the Rust Pup headquarters. If you've played Jemma 3 in which the head of the Rust Pups has introduced himself by name, you will get access to two new small interactions on certain days in the headquarters (located next to the library). They're only a few lines, but they include new art. Enjoy!

Note: I didn't work on the controller issue, but I plan on addressing it soon.

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
Some spelling changes. More changes to Skipnoise Ave to maybe make it load faster?
And. We may have solved the audio problem but I'm not sure. If someone who has the audio problem can let me know if it sounds any different, or equally as important, if it Doesnt, that would be dope. Enjoy the build!

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Here's what we've got for the 1.04 update:
I added an option that will appear when you launch the game on windows . It will allow you to use OpenGL instead of vulcan and your rendering driver. If you've been experiencing those weird missing background arts, try the OpenGL option. Otherwise, proceed with the default.
The OpenGL mode messed up one of the shaders in the game, but I added a thing that should disable that shader if you're using OpenGL. If anyone sees anything they suspect is a visual glitches on OpenGL mode, lemme know.

We also have some other simpler changes:
[list]
[*] Slight update to the background art in the hover cafe.
[*] Drink-making guide added the the hover cafe, appears After cafe tutorial is completed.
[*] Fixed invisible back button in Sal's room.
[*] Heather 13 is no longer flagged as explicit.
[*] Heather 6 no longer displays incorrect background at the end of the scene.
[*] and finally:
[*] I think I may have improved load times when entering Skipnoise Ave, but I'm not completely sure.
[/list]
Anyway, enjoy the build! <3

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
Fixed some settings menu behavior. Now if you're in controller mode and the menu detects mouse movement, it will show the mouse. Useful because some people seem to be automatically entering controller mode, which disables camera movement without a keyboard or controller. Also fixed a soft lock condition when the settings menu is exiting in the main menu while in controller mode. Also, the pan speed slider now actually does something.
We also did some spelling fixes and corrected a half-pixel incorrect positioning of neck-slot items in the dress up system.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Ok here's what we've got. Fixed a bug where the art was missing from the EM Driver scene in HC's appartment.
But more importantly:
I changed it so that the windows version of Hardcoded is no longer a PCK embedded exe. It is now an exe with a separate PCK. I'm hoping that this will solve the problem of the game not launching for some people on windows. If not, I will figure out how to do code signing. Let me know if this works!
